outcome: small for gestational age at birth
large for gestational age at birth
cohort: 196,670 participants from 25 cohort studies in Europe and North America
finding: Optimal gestational weight gain ranges were identified for each prepregnancy BMI category and were associated with a lower risk of adverse maternal and infant outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was lower among women who gained within the optimal gestational weight gain range for their prepregnancy BMI.
